interval: pointwise paired patient percentile 95%; conditional on fitted model, split, and simulated permissions
policy: Reuse parent validation-utility thresholds unchanged in every permission scenario; once and hourly
consent_scope: inference-time input availability only; parent models trained on full public benchmark features
utility: official full-stay challenge utility, distinct from clinical outcomes
primary_contrast: restricted minus full input on identical held-out patients
privacy: permitted source-hours and available observed-feature cells are exposure proxies, not measured leakage
